abstract: The return of inflation in Western economies has fueled the debate on its main drivers, bringing sector-specific shocks and supply chain bottlenecks to the forefront. Building on the seminal approach of Weber et al. (2024), this paper develops a method to assess the degree of exposure to these shocks in EU countries. Using inter-country input-output data stemming from the FIGARO database, we identify systemically significant sectors in four regions within the EU: Core, Southern Periphery, Eastern Periphery, and financial hubs. We also analyze exposure to foreign shocks. Two main conclusions can be drawn: on the one hand, periphery countries are more exposed to shocks originating in the EU core than the other way around; on the other hand, all EU regions are considerably exposed to price shocks originating from non-EU countries, namely Russia and China. The strategic dependencies of the block pose challenges for price stability and require targeted policies.

abstract: During China's transformation from a quantity‐oriented to a quality‐oriented trading nation, industrial policy consistency (IPC) between central and local governments has been an important driving force for firm exports. We investigate this IPC by extracting information on the preferential industries mentioned in the Chinese 10th to 12th Five‐Year Plans (FYPs) and empirically analyze the relationship between IPC and firm exports on the basis of Chinese firm‐level data from 2001 to 2015. The results indicate that IPC expands the firms' export scales but reduces the quality of products exported. This phenomenon is driven primarily by increasing subsidy reliance, intensifying excessive market competition and weakening innovation incentives. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that IPC has a more profound effect on the export outcomes of state‐owned enterprises, large firms, pillar industries and regions facing high levels of official promotion pressure. We further find that comparative advantages can relatively mitigate the decline in quality caused by policy consistency. Our findings have important policy implications for coordinating regional industrial policies and improving export competitiveness.

abstract: ABSTRACT There is an ongoing debate about the buffer‐stock saving hypothesis. This paper develops a formal test of the hypothesis by examining the sub‐unity of the marginal propensity to consume out of permanent income (MPCP). Our test relies on a novel estimator of the average derivative of a nonparametric consumption model, using constructed measures of latent permanent income shocks that accommodate nonparametric income distributions. Following Li and Vuong (1998), we use a Kotlarski‐based approach to account for asymmetric errors, which is crucial for testing buffer‐stock behavior. Applied to the US Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) data, our test rejects a unit MPCP, providing empirical support for buffer‐stock saving.
abstract_zh: 摘要 关于缓冲储备储蓄假说的争论仍在持续。本文通过检验永久收入边际消费倾向（MPCP）是否小于1，对该假说进行了正式检验。我们的检验依赖于一种非参数消费模型平均导数的创新估计方法，利用构建的潜在永久收入冲击度量，以适应非参数收入分布。遵循Li和Vuong（1998）的研究，我们采用基于Kotlarski的方法来处理非对称误差，这对于检验缓冲储备行为至关重要。应用于美国收入动态面板研究（PSID）数据后，我们的检验拒绝了MPCP等于1的假设，为缓冲储备储蓄提供了实证支持。
title: Inference on Buffer‐Stock Saving

abstract: This paper analyzes how interaction effects can be consistently estimated under economically plausible assumptions in linear panel models with a fixed ‐dimension. We advocate for a correlated interaction term effects (CITE) estimator and show that it is consistent under conditions that are not sufficient for consistency of the interaction term effect estimator that is most common in applied econometric work. Our paper discusses the empirical content of these conditions, shows that standard inference procedures can be applied to CITE, and analyzes consistency, relative efficiency, inference, and their finite sample properties in a simulation study. In an empirical application, we test whether labor displacement effects of robots are stronger in countries at higher income levels. The results are in line with our theoretical and simulation results and indicate that standard interaction term effect estimation underestimates the importance of a country's income level in the relationship between robots and employment and may prematurely reject a null hypothesis about interaction effects in the presence of misspecification.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在固定维度的线性面板模型中，如何在经济上合理的假设下一致地估计交互效应。我们提倡使用相关交互项效应（CITE）估计量，并证明在应用计量经济学工作中最常见的交互项效应估计量的一致性条件不充分的情况下，CITE仍能保持一致。本文讨论了这些条件的实证内容，展示了标准推断程序可应用于CITE，并通过模拟研究分析了其一致性、相对效率、推断及有限样本性质。在实证应用中，我们检验了机器人对劳动力替代效应是否在高收入国家更为显著。结果与我们的理论和模拟结果相符，表明标准交互项效应估计低估了国家收入水平在机器人与就业关系中的重要性，并可能在存在设定误差时过早拒绝关于交互效应的原假设。
title: Estimating Interaction Effects With Panel Data
title_zh: 使用面板数据估计交互效应

abstract: This paper studies empirical discrete‐choice games with incomplete information under nonparametric specifications of both the payoff function and the distribution of private information. It relaxes the standard global equilibrium assumption —under which players follow equilibrium strategies for all realizations of the control variables—and introduces a weaker local equilibrium assumption that requires the equilibrium restriction only for some, but not all, realizations. Under this maintained assumption and standard exclusion restrictions, I derive the testable implications of the global equilibrium hypothesis and establish the nonparametric identification of all unknown functions in the model. This paper also discusses settings where the local equilibrium condition applies. The method is illustrated through a Monte Carlo experiment and an empirical application examining the competition between KFC and McDonald's in China. The estimation results strongly reject the global equilibrium assumption.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全信息下的经验性离散选择博弈，其中支付函数和私人信息分布均采用非参数设定。它放宽了标准的全局均衡假设——该假设要求玩家对所有控制变量实现值都遵循均衡策略——并引入了一个较弱的局部均衡假设，仅要求在某些而非全部实现值上满足均衡约束。在此维持假设和标准排除性限制下，我推导出了全局均衡假设的可检验含义，并确立了模型中所有未知函数的非参数识别性。本文还讨论了局部均衡条件适用的情境。该方法通过蒙特卡洛实验和一项关于肯德基与麦当劳在中国竞争的实证应用进行了说明。估计结果强烈拒绝了全局均衡假设。

abstract: The rise of machine learning (ML) is one of the most prominent developments in applied econometrics in the past decade. The focus of much economic analysis is causal, rather than prediction, and Belloni et al. (2014) demonstrate how ML methods can be used in causal inference. This paper undertakes a narrow and wide replication of the Monte Carlo and empirical examples presented by Belloni et al. (2014). We discuss practical implications of this replication for the use of double ML methods in applied econometric research.
abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）的兴起是过去十年应用计量经济学领域最显著的发展之一。许多经济分析的重点在于因果推断，而非预测，Belloni等人（2014）展示了如何将机器学习方法应用于因果推断。本文对Belloni等人（2014）提出的蒙特卡洛模拟和实证案例进行了狭义与广义的复制研究。我们探讨了此次复制对于在应用计量经济学研究中使用双重机器学习方法的实际意义。
title: Double LASSO: Replication and Practical Insights
title_zh: 双重LASSO：复制与实用见解

abstract: The international co‐movement of interest rates reflects correlated business‐cycle fluctuations, largely driven by demand shocks. Monetary policy in advanced economies follows domestic mandates—inflation and the output gap—and does not respond to foreign policy shocks. We derive this result from a Bayesian structural panel vector autoregression with informative priors, homogeneity restrictions on contemporaneous relations, a hierarchical Minnesota prior with cross‐sectional shrinkage, and a factor structure for structural shocks.
abstract_zh: 国际利率的联动反映了商业周期波动的相关性，这主要由需求冲击驱动。发达经济体的货币政策遵循国内任务——通胀和产出缺口——并不对外国政策冲击作出反应。我们通过一个带有信息先验、同期关系同质性限制、具有横截面收缩的分层明尼苏达先验以及结构冲击因子结构的贝叶斯结构面板向量自回归模型得出这一结论。
title: What Explains International Interest Rate Co‐Movement?
title_zh: 什么解释了国际利率的联动性？

abstract: This paper leverages free‐form textual responses from a key manufacturing survey to create sentiment indexes that mirror categorical measures from the same survey and also contain predictive content—both in and out‐of‐sample—for manufacturing output. We use textual data from the Institute for Supply Management to compare sentiment metrics based on dictionary and deep learning natural language processing methods. The best performing sentiment measures classify comments based on fine‐tuned deep learning models. To add interpretability, we apply Shapley decompositions to show that a relatively small number of words—associated with very positive and very negative sentiment—account for much of the variation in the aggregate sentiment index.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一项关键制造业调查中的自由文本回复，构建了反映同一调查中分类指标的情绪指数，并包含对制造业产出的预测内容——无论是样本内还是样本外。我们使用供应管理研究所的文本数据，比较基于词典和深度学习自然语言处理方法的情感指标。表现最佳的情感度量基于微调深度学习模型对评论进行分类。为增强可解释性，我们应用Shapley分解，表明相对较少的词汇——与非常积极和非常消极情绪相关——解释了总体情绪指数的大部分变动。
title: Manufacturing Sentiment: Forecasting Industrial Production With Text Analysis
title_zh: 制造业情绪：基于文本分析的工业生产预测

abstract: ABSTRACT Words matter for predicting tail risks. We propose an attention mechanism embedded in a quantile factor model, yielding information that is quantile‐specific, target‐specific, and horizon‐specific. We establish new asymptotic results and show empirically that targeted textual data improve quantile forecasts of exchange‐rate returns and industrial production growth relative to strong benchmarks and other conditional‐quantile models. Bigrams and trigrams drive these gains, extending evidence that collocations enhance forecasting. A portfolio‐management application yields better allocations and higher risk‐adjusted performance. Robustness checks include a synthetic‐misinformation stress test, which shows that fabricated news does not create spurious predictability. Results are consistent across targets, horizons, and both rolling and recursive schemes.
abstract_zh: 词汇对于预测尾部风险至关重要。我们提出了一种嵌入分位数因子模型中的注意力机制，该机制能够生成针对特定分位数、特定目标及特定时间跨度的信息。我们建立了新的渐近结果，并实证表明，相较于强基准模型及其他条件分位数模型，针对性的文本数据能显著提升汇率收益率和工业生产增长的预测精度。二元词组和三元词组是这些改进的主要驱动力，进一步证实了搭配词能够增强预测能力的观点。一项投资组合管理应用实现了更优的资产配置和更高的风险调整后绩效。稳健性检验包括一项合成错误信息压力测试，该测试表明，虚构新闻不会产生虚假的可预测性。结果在目标、时间跨度以及滚动和递归方案中均保持一致。
title: Factor‐Based Quantile Forecasting With Textual Data
title_zh: 基于文本数据的因子分位数预测

abstract: This paper extends the vector autoregression framework by introducing a flexible distributional regression that models multivariate time series without imposing restrictive parametric distribution assumptions. We develop a distributional impulse response function that captures the future effect of distributional disturbances within the system, providing a more detailed view of dynamic heterogeneity. We propose a straightforward estimation method and establish its asymptotic properties under weak dependence assumptions. Our model, in an application to U.S. economic data, exhibits strong forecasting capabilities compared to existing alternatives. By examining distributional interactions and monetary policy impacts, particularly during the Great Recession, we uncover complex macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文通过引入一种灵活的分布回归方法，扩展了向量自回归框架，该方法在不施加严格参数分布假设的情况下对多元时间序列进行建模。我们开发了一种分布脉冲响应函数，用以捕捉系统内分布扰动的未来效应，从而更细致地揭示动态异质性。我们提出了一种简便的估计方法，并在弱依赖假设下确立了其渐近性质。在应用于美国经济数据时，我们的模型展现出相较于现有替代方法的强大预测能力。通过考察分布交互作用及货币政策影响，尤其是在大衰退期间，我们揭示了复杂的宏观经济动态。

abstract: We propose a method for defining, identifying, and estimating the marginal treatment effect (MTE) without imposing the instrumental variable (IV) assumptions of independence, exclusion, and separability (or monotonicity). Under a new definition of the MTE based on reduced‐form treatment error that is statistically independent of the covariates, we find that the relationship between the MTE and standard treatment parameters holds in the absence of IVs. We provide a set of sufficient conditions ensuring the identification of the defined MTE in an environment of essential heterogeneity. The key conditions include a linear restriction on potential outcome regression functions, a nonlinear restriction on the propensity score, and a conditional mean independence restriction which will lead to additive separability. We prove this identification using the notion of semiparametric identification based on functional forms. And we provide an empirical application for the Head Start program to illustrate the usefulness of the proposed method in analyzing heterogenous causal effects when IVs are elusive.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在不施加工具变量（IV）的独立性、排除性和可分离性（或单调性）假设的情况下，定义、识别和估计边际处理效应（MTE）的方法。基于与协变量统计独立的简化形式处理误差的新MTE定义，我们发现，在没有IV的情况下，MTE与标准处理参数之间的关系仍然成立。我们提供了一组充分条件，确保在本质异质性环境中所定义的MTE的可识别性。关键条件包括对潜在结果回归函数的线性限制、对倾向得分的非线性限制，以及导致加性可分离性的条件均值独立性限制。我们利用基于函数形式的半参数识别概念证明了这一识别。我们还提供了一个针对“领先起步”项目的实证应用，以说明在IV难以获得时，所提方法在分析异质性因果效应中的实用性。
title: Marginal Treatment Effects in the Absence of Instrumental Variables
title_zh: 无工具变量下的边际处理效应

abstract: A collection of time series are “related” if they follow similar stochastic processes and/or they are statistically dependent. This paper proposes a related time series (RTS) forecasting model that exploits these relationships. The model's foundation is a set of univariate Gaussian autoregressions, one for each series, which are then augmented to incorporate stochastic volatility, heavy‐tailed innovations, additive outliers, time‐varying parameters and common factors. The model is estimated and forecasts are computed using Bayesian methods with hierarchical priors that pool information across series. Computationally efficient MCMC methods are proposed. The RTS model is applied to three datasets and yields encouraging pseudo‐out‐of‐sample forecasting results.
abstract_zh: 一组时间序列若遵循相似的随机过程及/或存在统计依赖性，则被视为“相关”。本文提出了一种相关时间序列（RTS）预测模型，利用这些关系进行预测。该模型的基础是每个序列对应的一元高斯自回归模型，随后通过引入随机波动性、重尾创新、加性异常值、时变参数和共同因子进行扩展。模型估计及预测采用贝叶斯方法，并利用跨序列信息汇聚的分层先验。文中提出了计算高效的MCMC方法。RTS模型应用于三个数据集，产生了令人鼓舞的伪样本外预测结果。
title: Forecasting Related Time Series
title_zh: 预测相关时间序列

abstract: Using staggered state‐level changes in noncompete enforceability, we document that reduced enforcement increases profitability, valuation, productivity, and plant‐level growth in knowledge‐worker‐intensive firms relative to other firms. Critically, these gains are concentrated among the most productive knowledge‐worker firms, consistent with an assortative matching mechanism in which top firms attract the most productive workers when noncompetes no longer bind. Using inventor‐level data, we find direct evidence of this sorting: more productive inventors migrate toward more productive firms following reductions in enforceability. Consequently, performance dispersion widens across knowledge‐worker‐intensive industries, as the most productive firms pull further ahead of their less productive peers.
abstract_zh: 利用各州对竞业限制可执行性的交错调整，我们研究发现：相较于其他企业，降低竞业限制执行力度会提升知识密集型企业的盈利能力、估值、生产率及工厂层面的增长。关键的是，这些收益集中在最具生产力的知识密集型企业中，这与"分类匹配机制"的推论一致——当竞业限制不再具有约束力时，顶尖企业能够吸引最具生产力的劳动者。基于发明者层面的数据，我们发现了这种分类效应的直接证据：在竞业限制执行力度降低后，更具生产力的发明者会向更具生产力的企业迁移。由此，知识密集型行业内的绩效差距持续扩大，最具生产力的企业进一步拉开与低效同行的差距。
title: Worker Heterogeneity and the Effect of Noncompetes on Firm Performance
title_zh: 工人异质性与竞业限制对企业绩效的影响

abstract: We exploit a novel opportunity to study the dynamics of wage inequality and labor market competition over the course of economic development. Our context is Lithuania, where two decades of sustained growth and labor market tightening coincided with a substantial decline in wage inequality. We first fit a two-way fixed-effects model with worker and firm heterogeneity and document that the compression of the variance of firm fixed effects has been the main source of the fall in inequality. Guided by a standard dynamic monopsony model, we then estimate firms’ labor supply elasticities and show that labor market competition has increased over the same period. Finally, we construct a shift-share instrument and provide evidence that new job opportunities created by the accession to the European Union in 2004 contributed to the fall in inequality through their impact on labor market competition in Lithuania.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个新颖的研究机会，探讨经济发展过程中工资不平等与劳动力市场竞争的动态变化。我们的研究背景是立陶宛，该国在经历了二十年的持续增长和劳动力市场紧缩的同时，工资不平等显著下降。我们首先拟合了一个包含工人和企业异质性的双向固定效应模型，并记录到企业固定效应方差的压缩是导致不平等下降的主要因素。在标准动态买方垄断模型的指导下，我们随后估计了企业的劳动力供给弹性，并显示在同一时期内劳动力市场竞争有所增强。最后，我们构建了一个转移份额工具，并提供证据表明，2004年加入欧盟所创造的新就业机会，通过其对立陶宛劳动力市场竞争的影响，促进了不平等的下降。
title: Labor market competition and inequality
title_zh: 劳动力市场竞争与不平等

abstract: Does technological change affect ethical beliefs? We study the case of synthetic alternatives to meat products using an incentivized survey experiment. One might expect that the possibility of an improved alternative would increase objections to meat production on moral grounds because it reduces the cost of avoiding meat. Instead, we find that informing consumers of a new alternative decreases moral objections to conventional animal farming relative to a control. Participants who are experimentally nudged to view the new alternative relatively more positively do indeed report more moral concern for animal welfare. The findings suggest a backlash effect in which people react to innovation by increasing their support for existing practices, but depending on how positively they view the alternative.
title: The impact of new products on ethical beliefs
title_zh: 新产品对伦理信念的影响

abstract: This study examines the willingness to engage with others who hold opposing views, a key and understudied step for reducing polarization. A sample of 2,507 Americans is offered the opportunity to listen to opposing views on immigration, abortion and gun ownership. We find that, at baseline, a large fraction of participants are willing to listen, even without incentives and with an easy way out. Emphasizing common ground increases the willingness to engage and reconsider views on abortion and immigration. We discuss possible mechanisms that can explain increased engagement. We propose that emphasizing common ground increases the value of communication as a means to reason through an issue. These findings point to promising directions for interventions aimed at fostering dialogue across ideological divides.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人们与持对立观点者进行交流的意愿，这是减少极化过程中一个关键但尚未充分研究的环节。通过对2507名美国民众进行抽样调查，我们提供了倾听关于移民、堕胎和枪支管制等议题对立观点的机会。研究发现，在基线条件下，即使没有激励措施且存在便捷的退出途径，仍有相当比例的参与者愿意倾听。强调共同立场能够提升参与者就堕胎和移民议题进行交流并重新审视自身观点的意愿。我们探讨了可能解释这种参与度提升的潜在机制，并提出强调共同立场能够增强沟通作为理性探讨议题工具的价值。这些发现为旨在促进跨意识形态对话的干预措施指明了有前景的方向。
title: Breaking Echo Chambers: An Experimental Study on the Willingness to Listen to Opposite Views
title_zh: 打破回音室：倾听对立观点意愿的实验研究

abstract: We experimentally implement security-bid auctions, which are used around the world to sell projects that generate large, stochastic future cash flows. Buyers make bids with debt and equity, linking payments to the project’s ex-post revenue. Contrary to the theoretical predictions, we find that debt auctions generate more revenue than equity auctions. This is explained by overbidding in debt auctions. Furthermore, we find that second-price equity auctions generate slightly more surplus than other treatments. We also implement informal auctions and find that buyers use equity more often than theory predicts, and that sellers successfully choose dominant bids.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验实施了担保竞价拍卖，这类拍卖在全球范围内被用于出售产生大规模、随机未来现金流的项目。买家以债务和股权形式出价，将支付与项目的事后收入挂钩。与理论预测相反，我们发现债务拍卖比股权拍卖产生更高的收入。这一现象可通过债务拍卖中的过度出价来解释。此外，我们发现第二价格股权拍卖产生的剩余略高于其他处理方式。我们还实施了非正式拍卖，发现买家使用股权的频率高于理论预测，且卖家成功选择了占优出价。
title: Experimental Auctions with Securities

abstract: Distance-based road pricing can internalize driving externalities and provide fiscally sustainable infrastructure financing as vehicle electrification erodes fuel tax revenues. Yet, political resistance may pose a barrier to implementation. We provide the first comprehensive analysis of preferences for universal road pricing using a stated choice experiment with nearly 4000 Norwegian respondents. Policy alternatives vary systematically across urban peak prices, off-peak prices, non-urban prices, electric vehicle prices, and revenue allocation. We document robust majority support (70% to 80%) for most universal road pricing schemes, substantially exceeding typical support for local congestion charges. Support varies by design: public transport earmarking outperforms general budget allocation by eight percentage points, while moderate pricing dominates high pricing by six points. Support varies substantially with car use, urban versus rural residence, availability of transport alternatives, and institutional trust, but shows little sensitivity to income, toll exposure, or the likelihood of benefiting financially from road pricing. Latent class analysis identifies unconditional supporters (57%), systematic opponents (22%), and a persuadable middle (21%). Randomized information treatments generate modest effects, with factual information increasing support by 6 percentage points. Political barriers to road pricing may be lower than assumed with low to moderate pricing and credible infrastructure earmarking.
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Public support for universal road pricing
title_zh: 全民道路收费的公众支持度

abstract: Understanding how financial reporting shapes firms’ innovation strategies is central to research at the intersection of accounting and strategic management. While prior studies examine the informational role of financial reporting, the impact of financial statement comparability (FSC) on innovation choices remains underexplored. Drawing on data from Chinese A-share listed firms, this study explores how FSC shapes firms’ choices between specialization-oriented and diversification-oriented innovation strategies. We find that higher FSC is significantly associated with greater related variety but has no significant effect on specialization or unrelated variety. Heterogeneity analyses show that the effect is stronger in high-tech industries and that FSC facilitates unrelated diversification among state-owned enterprises and firms in the decline stage of the firm life cycle. In the green innovation domain, FSC primarily promotes specialization rather than diversification. Additional tests reveal important boundary conditions: financing constraints weaken, whereas lower market competition strengthens, the positive association between FSC and related variety. Managerial and organizational factors also matter. CEO functional diversity reduces the marginal effect of FSC, whereas dynamic capabilities strengthen it up to a certain threshold. Our study provides new evidence on the role of financial disclosure in shaping firms’ innovation strategies and offers useful insights for practitioners.

abstract: This study examines the relationship between institution-level intercollegiate athletic success and the academic quality of incoming freshmen classes at U.S. universities. While much of the economics literature emphasizes single-sport success, we measure athletic performance using Learfield Directors’ Cup points, which capture success across all sports. Econometric specifications are tested in which freshman quality is proxied by SAT scores, ACT scores, and high school GPAs. The empirical results consistently indicate that marginal increases in Learfield Directors’ Cup points are linked to higher standardized test scores and higher high school GPAs.
title: Everything schools: university athletic performance and the quality of incoming freshmen
title_zh: 一切皆学校：大学体育表现与新生质量

abstract: We study the relevance of global shocks in determining r-star for a set of typically studied advanced open economies (Australia, Canada, Euro Area, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden, and the United Kingdom). To do so, we apply a multivariate Beveridge–Nelson decomposition using a two-block small open economy Bayesian vector autoregression for each economy with the United States in the foreign block and imposing long-run restrictions to identify the role of global shocks in driving domestic r-star. We document three key findings: (i) U.S. r-star provides a sufficient proxy for global r-star from the perspective of these seven open economies; (ii) local shocks with no impact on U.S. r-star are important for domestic r-stars, leaving open the potential that domestic macroeconomic policies can complement or offset the global forces determining r-star; and (iii) even though local shocks are important, global forces played the dominant role in the long-term decline in r-stars for all seven open economies following the global financial crisis.
title: How important is global r-star for open economies?
title_zh: 全球r-star对开放经济体的重要性如何？

abstract: Maize varietal turnover is widely promoted across Sub-Saharan Africa to improve crop productivity and increase food security, yet its impact on yields remains poorly understood amid heterogeneous agroecological and socioeconomic conditions. This study quantifies the yield effects of varietal age in Kenya using a three-wave panel survey (2023-2024) of 4,160 smallholder households across Kenya. Using entropy balancing and weighted regression models to isolate the effect of varietal age on maize yield, we find a strong and consistent relationship between varietal age and yield. New varieties yield 147 kg/ha more than old ones in the long rains and 91 kg/ha more in the short rains. Finer age categorization reveals that switching to ultra-new varieties (0-5 years) delivers the highest gains-360 kg/ha over ultra-old varieties (21+ years) in the long rains and 269 kg/ha in the short rains. These findings suggest that slow varietal turnover carries significant opportunity costs in the form of forgone yield gains. While farmers generally perceive new varieties favorably-particularly for yield potential, early maturity and grain quality-concerns around labor intensity and resilience remain, potentially dampening adoption. Providing farmers with clear, locally relevant performance data and opportunities for on-farm experimentation can help shift perceptions and support wider uptake. Policies and programs that expand access to newer, better-performing varieties and strengthen seed quality assurance are essential for translating genetic gains into productivity improvements across Kenya's bimodal maize production systems.
title: Is newer better? The effect of varietal age on real-world maize yield in Kenya
title_zh: 新品种更好吗？品种年龄对肯尼亚实际玉米产量的影响

abstract: We provide a theorem on the role of risk and risk attitudes in macroeconomic models that clarifies and extends the Tallarini (2000) separation result. Under (1) separation of intertemporal and risk preferences, (2) separation of drivers of first and higher moments in the model primitives, and (3) approximate linearity of constraints, risk aversion and time-varying risk are irrelevant for the elasticity of any endogenous variable with respect to state variables that don’t drive variation in higher moments. We discuss how models generate a more prominent role for risk by “breaking” or “adapting” to the assumptions in the theorem.
title: An irrelevance theorem for risk aversion and time-varying risk
title_zh: 风险厌恶与时变风险的不相关定理

abstract: Globally, state-based armed conflict has increased by more than 50 percent over the past decade. The environmental consequences of such conflict are often overlooked. To help fill that gap, we examine the effect on forest cover of conflict-related forced displacement in Colombia. We use fine-scale annual data on forest cover change derived from satellite images along with data culled from court records of displacement events, using computational text analysis, to estimate staggered difference-in-differences models. We find that displacement leads to a 50 percent increase in deforestation. This effect is likely due to the expansion of both legal and illegal economic activities following displacement. It is most pronounced when paramilitary groups are the sole actors involved in displacement and where economic returns to cleared land uses are high. In principle, these results could be used to target efforts to reduce environmental damage associated with civil conflict.
title: No man’s land? The effect of forced displacement on forest cover change in Colombia
title_zh: 无人之地？强迫迁移对哥伦比亚森林覆盖变化的影响

abstract: Public procurement in developing countries accounts for approximately 13% of GDP, offering a significant market opportunity for domestic firms, especially those facing demand constraints. This paper explores the impact of selling to government entities on firm performance in Uganda, leveraging detailed administrative data and an event study methodology that corrects for firm self-selection and heterogeneity in the timing of the treatment. The results reveal that while firms increase their total sales after entering government contracts, they do not see improvements in productivity (measured by value added per worker). Moreover, sales to non-government customers drop sharply. This reallocation effect is persistent. This effect is not observed when firms start to sell to large private-sector buyers. Drawing on an original survey of firms engaged in public procurement, we highlight potential drivers of these dynamics, including capacity constraints and profitability differences between public and private sector sales.
title: Government demand and firm growth
title_zh: 政府需求与企业成长

abstract: As income rises, the risk of disability in old age declines, while life expectancy increases. These correlations strengthen the case for public long-term care (LTC) insurance over public pension systems. However, this perspective shifts when considering family solidarity—specifically, the informal care provided by spouses and children to elderly relatives. When viewed through the lens of altruistic caregiving motives, the argument for social LTC insurance becomes more nuanced. The interplay between formal and informal care is a key factor in shaping optimal policy. In this paper, we demonstrate that when family members reliably provide informal care, the design of a comprehensive public LTC system depends on the existence of a private insurance and on the degree of substitutability between informal and formal care.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Public pensions and LTC insurance with family solidarity
title_zh: 家庭团结视角下的公共养老金与长期护理保险

abstract: This study utilizes locations of underground publications, known as samizdat , to analyze the impact of access to political knowledge on shaping institutional change in the German Democratic Republic during 1989–1990. Survival analysis reveals that regions with greater underground press activity were significantly more likely to experience protests following the fall of the Berlin Wall on November 9, 1989. This delay can be attributed to the increased repression of dissent. However, support for regime change did not necessarily translate into support for rapid German reunification, as evidenced by the voting results of the 1990 democratic elections. Although samizdat did not appear to coordinate the initial protests, it played an informational role in shaping preferences toward gradual institutional change. Finally, in addition to its information function, underground press activities were instrumental in forming opposition that challenged the non-democratic regime, thereby determining the onset of democratization.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用地下出版物（即“萨米兹达特”）的地点分布，分析政治知识获取对1989–1990年德意志民主共和国制度变革的影响。生存分析显示，在1989年11月9日柏林墙倒塌后，地下出版活动更为活跃的地区更有可能发生抗议活动。这一延迟可归因于对异见行为加强的压制。然而，对政权更迭的支持并不必然转化为对快速德国统一的支持，1990年民主选举的投票结果即为明证。尽管萨米兹达特似乎并未协调最初的抗议活动，但它在塑造偏好渐进式制度变革方面发挥了信息作用。最后，除信息功能外，地下出版活动在形成挑战非民主政权的反对派方面也至关重要，从而决定了民主化的启动。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Loose bricks in the wall: Underground press and political opposition in non-democracies
title_zh: 墙上的松动砖块：非民主国家的地下媒体与政治反对

abstract: Networks frequently experience attrition as individual members exit over time. Such departures can significantly impact the behavior of their peers and have cascading effects on overall network activity. We investigate such effects within the framework of the canonical linear-quadratic model of peer influence. We introduce an exogenous shock that removes certain agents from the network, with the key feature that only their immediate neighbors observe these departures. In this setting of incomplete information, we characterize the equilibrium behavior using the Bonacich centrality defined over the belief structures of the agents. We propose the concept of an agent’s expected marginal contribution, quantifying the impact of their presence or absence on aggregate network activity. This metric has direct policy relevance: it enables a planner to identify strategically important agents for targeted intervention: either to preserve their participation and enhance collective effort, or to remove them to reduce activity.
title: Network attrition: Theory and policy implications
title_zh: 网络损耗：理论与政策启示

abstract: What are the effects of supply-side climate policies in the oil market? We use global company-level data to estimate the impact of 84 reforms of production taxes between 2000 and 2019 on oil production, exploration, and discoveries. We find that higher taxes primarily reduce companies’ exploration expenditures and oil discoveries, and also reduce short-term production of unconventional oil. We then quantify the implications for the oil market using a short- and medium-term dynamic model extending until the end of the century. Imposing a global climate royalty surcharge of 20 percentage points on oil producers reduces average annual emissions from oil by 5–7% in the first 5 years, and 9–20% in the medium term. If only OECD countries adopt this policy, 47–73% of the total emission reductions would be offset by increased production in non-OECD countries in the medium term.
abstract_zh: 供给侧气候政策对石油市场有何影响？我们利用全球企业层面数据，估算了2000年至2019年间84项生产税改革对石油产量、勘探及发现量的影响。研究发现，提高税率主要降低了企业的勘探支出和石油发现量，同时减少了非常规石油的短期产量。随后，我们通过一个延伸至本世纪末的短期与中期动态模型，量化了这些影响对石油市场的含义。若对石油生产商征收20个百分点的全球气候特许权附加费，前五年内石油年均排放量将减少5%至7%，中期内减少9%至20%。若仅由经合组织国家实施该政策，中期内47%至73%的减排总量将被非经合组织国家的产量增长所抵消。
title: Quantifying Supply-Side Climate Policies
title_zh: 量化供给侧气候政策

abstract: This paper addresses two main questions. First, what proportion of people are exposed to climate hazards in Latin America and the Caribbean, especially among the poor versus the nonpoor? Second, do certain areas—hotspots—have high rates of bothhazard exposure and poverty that require targeted policy? Using poverty maps and georeferenced climate hazard data, three innovations are introduced: five climate hazards are analyzed (droughts, hurricanes, heatwaves, floods, and landslides); official poverty data at administrative level 2 are used, instead of only administrative level 1; and an interpolation method estimates poverty-plus-exposure rates across countries with varying data sources. The estimates indicate that 36.9 percent of the population is exposed to at least one of the five climate hazards under consideration. Considering the population in poverty only, the percentage is higher, 44.6 percent, whereas the exposure rate for the nonpoor is 34.0 percent. Some areas experience high exposure to climate hazards and high poverty rates. These hotspots include about 10 percent of the region’s population. These areas are in the Brazilian northeast; the upper-Amazon region of Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Brazil; the Chaco region of Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay; the islands of the Caribbean; the western coast of the Gulf of California; and the Yucatan Peninsula.
abstract_zh: 本文主要探讨两个问题：第一，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区有多少人口暴露于气候灾害中，尤其是贫困与非贫困群体之间的差异？第二，是否存在某些区域——即灾害暴露与贫困率均较高的“热点地区”——需要针对性政策干预？通过整合贫困地图与地理参照气候灾害数据，本文引入三项创新：分析五种气候灾害（干旱、飓风、热浪、洪水和山体滑坡）；采用二级行政区划的官方贫困数据（而非仅使用一级行政区划数据）；并运用插值法估算不同数据来源国家间的“贫困-暴露”复合率。估算结果显示，36.9%的人口至少暴露于所研究的五种气候灾害之一。若仅考虑贫困人口，该比例上升至44.6%，而非贫困人口的暴露率为34.0%。部分区域同时呈现高气候灾害暴露率与高贫困率，这些热点地区约占区域总人口的10%，主要分布于巴西东北部；哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁与巴西的上亚马逊地区；阿根廷、巴西与巴拉圭的大查科地区；加勒比群岛；加利福尼亚湾西海岸以及尤卡坦半岛。
title: Are the Poor More Exposed to Climate Hazards in Latin America?
title_zh: 拉丁美洲的穷人是否更容易遭受气候灾害？
